6 x 1 = 6.0

Total = 21.6

B = 7 . 6 2 1 . 6 × 1 0 0 = 3 5 . 1 8 ≈ 3 5 %

C = 5 . 0 2 1 . 6 × 1 0 0 = 2 3 . 1 5 ≈ 2 3 %

D = 6 . 0 2 1 . 6 × 1 0 0 = 2 7 . 8 ≈ 2 8 %

questions.q:
Arrange the following compounds in decreasing order of their boiling points
(i) CH3Cl
(ii) CH3CH2Cl
(iii) CH3CH2CH2Cl
(iv) CH3CH2CH2CH2Cl
questions.solution:
Boiling point of the given compounds decreases in the following order as when molecular weight decreases magnitude of Van der Waal's forces also decreases so boiling point also decreases.
CH3CH2CH2CH2Cl>CH3CH2CH2Cl>CH3CH2Cl>CH3Cl
